'''Heinz Bachmann''' (1924 – 22 April 2022)<ref>{{cite web |title=Zum Hinschied von Dr. Heinz Bachmann (1924 bis 2022) |url=https://www.datocms-assets.com/132730/1726472970-jahresbericht-2021_22.pdf |website=Freies Gymnasium Zürich |access-date=29 December 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250805150448/https://www.datocms-assets.com/132730/1726472970-jahresbericht-2021_22.pdf|url-status=live|archive-date=5 August 2025}}</ref> was a [[mathematician]] who worked at the Eidgenössische Sternwarte (federal observatory) in [[Zürich]]. He introduced the [[Bachmann–Howard ordinal]] and [[ordinal collapsing function]]s, which are essential tools in studying [[Proof theoretic ordinal|proof-theoretic ordinals]].<ref>{{Citation |last=Rathjen |first=Michael |title=Proof Theory |date=2024 |work=The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy |editor-last=Zalta |editor-first=Edward N. |url=https://plato.stanford.edu/archives/win2024/entries/proof-theory/ |access-date=2026-08-12 |edition=Winter 2024 |publisher=Metaphysics Research Lab, Stanford University |last2=Sieg |first2=Wilfried |editor2-last=Nodelman |editor2-first=Uri}}</ref>
